purpose: Evaluate one fixed queue-gated NSESche mechanism on the complete retained E1 homogeneous low E01-E20 training block. The gate addresses the directly observed NSESche backlog mechanism without changing the paper welfare, Nash coordination, common HPA, workload, baselines, metrics, or reference construction.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_high_disposition: retain the frozen NSESche-high-final-v1 historical block unchanged

diagnosis_and_independence.first_principles_failure: Across the complete 20-seed block V150 accumulated about 31 times the OCS request-frame queue area, with mean pending-plus-runnable density about 25.343 tasks per node and p95 about 45.655. This explains its latency and cost loss without treating the technically valid OCS baseline as faulty.
diagnosis_and_independence.threshold_origin: 8.0 is an existing preregistered runtime queue-density boundary already implemented and tested before V155; it was not numerically fitted to maximize a V155 outcome.
diagnosis_and_independence.adaptive_training_disclosure: E01-E20 outcomes motivated the queue-control intervention, so V155 on E01-E20 is explicitly training-only and cannot authorize a paper superiority claim.
diagnosis_and_independence.baseline_fault_disposition: Orion and OCS use the same frozen paired tapes, environments, common HPA, observation window, and QC contract; their strong low-load results are attributed to their mechanisms unless a result-blind technical audit proves otherwise. No such fault is currently present.

training_design.technical_retry_rule: Only the frozen same-cell technical retry policy may retry a technical failure; every failed attempt remains archived and no QC-passing attempt is replaced.

selection_rule.mean_gate: For each primary metric, V155 mean must be strictly greater than the maximum mean among all nine frozen non-NSESche low-load baselines.
selection_rule.paired_gate: For each primary metric, V155 minus its preregistered comparator must be strictly positive on at least 12 of 20 paired seeds. Finite-only QPR additionally requires finite V155 QPR on all 20 seeds; zero-completed-as-zero retains all 20.
selection_rule.mechanism_gate: Every scheduler window reports queue density, threshold 8, and the selected exact expert; the selected expert must equal Hiku2/OCS Borda iff density is below 8 and exact OCS otherwise; both routes must be exercised somewhere in the complete block.
selection_rule.joint_training_pass: All three mean gates, all three paired gates, finite-QPR coverage, and the mechanism gate pass.
selection_rule.failure: Retain the complete V155 block and retire this mechanism without threshold search, seed replacement, or confirmation inputs.

before_reveal: exact low E01-E20 product in the committed order
exact frozen V155 source commit, binary, environment, tapes, common HPA, and policy-independent references
all QC-passing canonicals retained with valid ledger and pairing and no unexplained quarantine
one unanimous runtime identity and exact reference build/replay pairing
run_config contains the V155 contract with threshold 8 and no completion-outcome input
each of 20000 scheduler windows contains the V155 route telemetry and route agrees exactly with current queue density
zero throughput, completion, latency, cost, QPR, or aggregate outcome fields parsed before the blind audit is sealed
